errors.description: key_share_q is a multi-bit value produced in key_clk and sampled directly in crypto_clk without a bundled-data handshake or hold guarantee.
key_valid_pulse_q is a one-cycle key_clk pulse consumed directly in crypto_clk, so the event can be missed or sampled metastably.
key_valid_toggle_q reconverges with a one-sample crypto_clk history, allowing metastability or double-counting in crypto_event_o.
key_mode_sync_q receives independently synchronized bits from encoded control vector key_mode_q before decoding in crypto_clk, so transient illegal modes can be observed.
key_rst_n is used as data inside crypto_clk logic, so reset deassertion can asynchronously change destination state.
bus_snapshot_q combines key_clk payload state with crypto_clk status state in bus_clk without a cross-domain snapshot protocol.
